name: Agent Forensic Audit
tagline: A paid reconstruction of what the agent actually did.
summary: Deep-dive on a deployed agent: full audit-trail reconstruction, failure-mode analysis, drift report, remediation list. The wedge product. Converts into OBS subscriptions and feeds underwriting data for product line 01. This week's play.
description: Agent Forensic Audit is a single paid engagement against one deployed agent. The work is reconstruction, not a dashboard login. The trail is rebuilt, failure modes are named, drift is scored, and the buyer leaves with a remediation list they can act on. It is priced to be a yes. It is scoped to convert: the last page of the report is the OBS subscription that would have caught this. Telemetry from the engagement is underwriting fuel.
buyer: Anyone with a deployed agent they no longer fully trust — after an incident, before a board review, or as a condition of putting the agent in front of customers.

features.name: Audit trail reconstruction
features.detail: Rebuild the hash-chained execution log. Say what happened, in order, with attribution.

features.name: Failure-mode analysis
features.detail: Name the ways this agent actually fails, not the ways the prompt said it would not.

features.name: Drift report
features.detail: Persona and vector drift against the enrolled baseline, with the nine quality dimensions trended where data exists.

features.name: Remediation list
features.detail: Ordered actions. The last items are the OBS SKUs that keep this from being a one-time firefight.

deliverables: Remediation list with OBS conversion path

source_components.maps_to: Trail reconstruction from the signed, hash-chained log.
Nine-dimension quality section of the report.

readiness.next_action: This week's play. Sell the engagement. Convert the report into OBS-02 / OBS-03. File the telemetry into underwriting.
